objective.per_epoch_workload: B_e = 5 MiB (the frozen epoch byte floor), identical for every C
objective.static_completion: T_fixed(C) = sum over retained shared-valid epochs of t[C,e]
objective.instantaneous_oracle: T_instantaneous = sum_e B_e / max_C R[C,e] (diagnostic only)
objective.constrained_oracle: minimize sum_e t[C_e,e] + sum over changes tau(from,to)
objective.statistical_unit: trace (n=2 pilot traces; descriptive only; final trace-level gate pending more traces)

action_space.transitions: stay, or exactly one ladder step per epoch boundary; direct jumps forbidden
action_space.dwell: after a change at boundary e, C_{e+1} must equal C_e (the new value is held for at least one complete following epoch)
action_space.invalid_state: non-ladder C or dwell violation is rejected by ValidateSchedule

tau.units: seconds of equivalent B_e = 5 MiB completion time
tau.injection_window: one complete 120 s epoch starting at the preselected trace-time boundary
tau.formula: tau = (control_bytes - switched_bytes) / (control_bytes / 120 s); negative values preserved; control_bytes == 0 makes the observation invalid and the denominator undefined (reported explicitly)
tau.control: matched fixed-C run at the target C over the identical trace-time window; the protocol-v2 fixed-C pilot artifacts are used read-only
tau.switch_timing: the child forces the target C at child-elapsed = epoch start (within the frozen 100 ms anchor tolerance); the whole 120 s window is measured
tau.observation_validity: a switched-run observation is valid only if the run reached the watchdog window, the switch applied, control_bytes > 0, and switched_bytes > 0; a zero-byte switched window indicates transfer never established and is not a switch measurement

regime_classifier.source: native downlink delivery opportunities only (never downloader throughput)
regime_classifier.epochs: full 120 s epochs over the downlink trace; the final partial epoch is excluded
regime_classifier.degraded: the k lowest rates (ties: lower epoch index first)
regime_classifier.good: the k highest rates not already degraded (ties: lower epoch index first); disjoint from degraded
regime_classifier.recovering: e > 0 with rate[e] >= 1.25 * rate[e-1] and e not degraded
regime_classifier.precedence: degraded, then recovering, then good, else middle
regime_classifier.injection_selection: for regimes in the order degraded, good, recovering: the earliest full epoch of that regime and, when at least one more exists, the next distinct epoch of the same regime; absent regimes contribute nothing

tau_aggregation.pooled: median of all valid observations for the direction
tau_aggregation.regime_medians: median of valid observations per regime
tau_aggregation.regime_specific_rule: use regime-specific tau iff at least two regimes have valid observations, all regime medians are > 0, and max(regime_median)/min(regime_median) >= 2.0
tau_aggregation.undefined_ratio: if the minimum regime median is <= 0 the ratio is undefined; report explicitly and use the pooled tau
tau_aggregation.median_definition: average of the two middle values for an even count
